# montecarlo_ingestion_key (Data Source)

An ingestion key is a key id and secret that pushes metadata, lineage, query logs, ETL jobs and runs, or BI assets to the one warehouse or container it is scoped to. The secret is returned only when the key is created. A warehouse or container can hold several keys, so create the new one before deleting the old one when rotating.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key_id` (String) Id of the integration key, as returned when it is created or listed.

### Read-Only

- `bi_container_id` (String) The BI container the key pushes BI assets to. Null when the key is scoped to something else.
- `created_time` (String) When the key was created.
- `description` (String) What this key is for.
- `etl_container_id` (String) The ETL container the key pushes ETL jobs and runs to. Null when the key is scoped to something else.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the key.
- `mcd_id` (String) Key id to present, as the `x-mcd-id` header or a client's `mcd_id` setting. The same value as `id`.
- `warehouse_id` (String) The warehouse the key pushes metadata, lineage and query logs to. Null when the key is scoped to a container.
